# Formato de Investigaciones (`investigacion`)

> Rust CLI and full-screen terminal menu that turns an academic paper written in Markdown into a PDF: Pandoc → LaTeX (format + design) → pdflatex. Format: APA 7 only. Design: geometric-cover (built-in), or user-made ones in my-templates/designs/. Images: PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG and WEBP (SVG/WEBP converted to PNG inside the program). Cover data comes from course profiles (courses/<key>.toml) or `--set NAME=value`. Interface in Spanish or English; papers Spanish by default. Runs on Linux and Windows; macOS is planned. GPL-3.0-or-later.

Facts that are easy to get wrong:

- The Markdown holds only the content. The program adds the cover, title, author, date and table of contents.
- There is no `.env`. Data precedence: CLI option (including `--set UNIVERSIDAD=…`) > course profile. `settings.toml` only remembers the interface language (`IDIOMA`), the menu theme (`TEMA`), the work folder (`CARPETA_TRABAJO`, where input/, output/, courses/, my-templates/designs/ and logos/ live) and an optional `LOGOS` folder.
- Running `investigacion` with no arguments opens the menu; with arguments it is the CLI.
- Retired names still load with a one-line warning: `--format`/profile `format` (anything but apa7), profile `semester`, designs apa, apa-simple, classic-cover, report, starter (they use geometric-cover). There are no user formats.
- A missing or unconvertible image, a bad logo, an unknown symbol or a missing Graphviz is a warning. A broken ```pgfplot``` or ```tikz``` block and broken `$…$` math are the only intended hard failures, because both are real LaTeX.
- Diagnostic log: `cache/logs/investigacion.log` (`INVESTIGACION_LOG=debug|off`).

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what it is, install, first use
- [docs/usage.md](docs/usage.md): basic use of the menu and the CLI
- [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md): every command, option, alias, environment variable and exit code
- [docs/reference.md](docs/reference.md): complete reference: pipeline, profiles, format, designs, markers, Markdown syntax, filters, compilation, logging, troubleshooting
- [docs/install.md](docs/install.md): installation per OS

## Prompts

- [docs/prompts/paper.md](docs/prompts/paper.md): prompt for an AI to write a paper that uses every supported element
- [docs/prompts/design.md](docs/prompts/design.md): prompt for an AI to turn a cover description into a compatible design (template.ltx + template.toml)
